findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: The person in charge (PIC) at today’s inspection was not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM). Medium risk establishments must have a CFPM present in the building during all times during which food is being handled to oversee proper food handling and safe temperatures. Inspector provided information on ANSI-approved courses to obtain a CFPM certificate. Ensure a CFPM is always available during times of food handling.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed raw ground pork stored above mandarin oranges in the standing cooler during today’s inspection. CORRECTED- oranges were moved above the raw meat. Inspector provided a storage order infographic to the PIC. Ensure all ready to eat (RTE) foods are stored above raw foods to prevent cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food. [P]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Two cartons of eggs were observed on the top shelf of the vertical cooler. CORRECTED- PIC moved the eggs to the black personal foods cooler as they were not intended for service. Ensure raw foods are stored below ready-to-eat foods. Store personal foods in the designated cooler.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Quat sanitizer in the 3 compartment sink observed at 100ppm. CORRECTED- PIC added two additional pumps of concentrated sanitizer to the sink (6 pumps total). Sanitizer was then observed at 400ppm. Ensure sanitizer is made to an effective concentration.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have a concentration based on label (200-400ppm). [P]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Probe thermometer could not be located during this inspection. Ensure a probe thermometer is available for monitoring food temperatures.
4-302.12: (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets. [Pf]
